column1: # The star's chain, in landing order: slug, source branch, owner, and optional riders (test-only
# branches merged in below the source, landing on the slice's whole gate). A rider rides only once its
# own fast gate is green alone on main, at most three per slice, in this order. star-train.py stacks each slice on
# the one above it and lands the bottom one when it's green (Kirk and @system_adamic, October 8).
